diffs.diff: header pin 1: part says GND, datasheet reading says SCL
diffs.evidence: In the SparkFun Eagle board file the six left-edge PTH holes are one column at x=1.27 (J7 1x04 SCL/SDA/3.3V/GND as pads 1-4 from y=11.43 upward, J1 1x02 VIN/GND below), and the silkscreen labels read top to bottom GND, 3.3V, SDA, SCL, VIN, GND; J7 pad 4 (GND) sits at the top of the left column y=19.05, e.g. '<element name="U$4" library="output" package="#GND#0" value="" x="6.096" y="19.05"' - the second reading listed Eagle pad numbers of J7 then J1, which is not the physical order along the edge, while the model follows the printed top-to-bottom order.

diffs.diff: physical layout: the board has 2 header rows, but this small module is modelled as plugging in as a single row
diffs.evidence: Both I2C/power headers are placed at the same x on the left edge, '<element name="J7" library="SparkFun-Connectors" package="1X04_NO_SILK" value="" x="1.27" y="11.43"' and '<element name="J1" library="SparkFun-Connectors" package="1X02_NO_SILK" value="" x="1.27" y="8.89"', forming a single 6-pin 0.1in column; the only other header (J5, x=90.17) is the far-edge LED output for chaining APA102 strips ('routed the LED control signals out to a dedicated 0.1"-spaced PTH header on the edge of the board'), not a second row of the module's I2C header.
